verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs describe Protect, its risk-management system, as offering machine-learning fraud detection trained on global transaction data. Protect also lets users create, backtest, and label custom rules in a rule builder interface. Each payment gets a risk evaluation that results in a block, allow, or review action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation showing how individual custom rules map to block/review/allow actions and how fraud scores are surfaced to finance-ops users.
